# Popover

Rich content in a floating panel, opened by click.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** Plan details and fee explanations, opened by tap on any device.

- **Use it when:** Extra detail or a small control next to what it explains, on any device.
- **Not when:** A one-line hint (tooltip), or a task that should block the page (dialog).

Instead:

- [Tooltip](./tooltip.md): A one-line hint on hover.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A blocking task.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape closes it and returns focus. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The trigger says it opens a panel and whether it is open. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add popover
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Popover reads 1 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. A row marked Themeable changes between light and dark. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Popover's tokens to change Popover alone.
